title: The global nilpotent cone for universal curves
summary: We construct a conic Lagrangian in the cotangent bundle of the moduli stack of $G$-bundles over the universal curve, restricting to the global nilpotent cone for each curve. It gives rise to a singular support condition suitable for the Betti geometric Langlands correspondence for families of curves and the automorphic gluing functor studied in arXiv: 2105.12318. We also prove a family version of ``local constancy of Hecke operators," generalizing our earlier result.
